issue.title: Read-only bead paths auto-initialize stores and attempt SDD-init commits
issue.description:
Read-only bead lookups still auto-initialize the bead store and attempt SDD-init commits in whatever repo the cwd resolves to, even for display-only lookups.

Chain: get_read_view() -> get_project() -> init_beads() in src/sase/bead/cli_common.py; init_beads() calls ensure_bare_git_sdd_initialized(root, commit=True, push=False) for BEADS_DIRNAME stores. The attachment doctor (inspect_attachment_health) and plan-archive doctor reach it through get_read_view, so display-only paths can write/commit generated SDD scaffolding into the resolved checkout. The stray-root-sdd plan (202610/remove_stray_root_sdd_dir.md) isolated the four known leaky tests and hardened is_local_bare_git_workspace, but the read path itself still mutates.

Desired: read-only resolution never initializes or commits; it should open the existing store or report unavailable.

task_type_fields.impact: Display-only lookups can write and commit generated SDD scaffolding into an unrelated checkout.
task_type_fields.repro: Call get_read_view() with cwd resolving to a checkout without a bead store; init_beads() runs ensure_bare_git_sdd_initialized(commit=True).

issue.creation_reason: Follow-up from the approved stray-root-sdd removal plan; the read path still mutates whatever checkout cwd resolves to.
